data.one_liner: Lightweight, customizable loading and toast overlay for Flutter without BuildContext.
data.what_it_does: Provides a global loading, progress, result, and toast overlay that can be triggered from anywhere in the application without requiring a BuildContext. Supports built-in indicators, custom widgets, animations, and per-call options.
use_when: You need to display global loading spinners or success/error toasts without passing a BuildContext down the widget tree.
You want customizable indicator types, toast positions, and animations.
You require determinate progress indicators or custom widget overlays.
avoid_when: Your application architecture strictly mandates declarative UI state for overlays.
You prefer fully localized snackbar or banner widgets embedded directly inside a Scaffold.
strengths: Can be called globally without a BuildContext.
Supports loading, determinate progress, result states, toasts, and custom widgets.
Provides extensive configuration options and immutable per-call overrides.
weaknesses: Relies on a global imperative API rather than a purely declarative widget-tree approach.
Requires inserting EasyLoading.init() at the root of the application.
data.setup_notes: Add the dependency and attach EasyLoading.init() to the builder of your MaterialApp or CupertinoApp.
